protocol.observer: simulation truth; previous completed wheel feedback; no sensor estimator
protocol.world: independent horizontal Bullet plane; gravity -9.81; no window
protocol.initialization: zero speed; airborne pose assigned once before first step; no runtime reset
protocol.driver_brake: full throttle throughout; full brake from 2s (priority conflict)
protocol.slip_metric: supported wheels only; absolute kappa; diagnostic threshold 0.2
protocol.comparison: same car, initial conditions and commands; only tcs_enabled differs within each pair
protocol.scope: mechanism evidence only; acceleration/distance/yaw improvement not mandatory; no high-fidelity completion claim
